I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I told him the Bay 24 site for the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines is still unverified and someone on the account team needs to confirm it before anyone plans around it.

I only checked what Hollis can see himself, which is #central-team and the public shared files. Neither one confirms Bay 24 or rules it out. I didn't read the Quarrendon incident channel or the North channels because he isn't a member. I also skipped `search_messages`, since its results include conversations he can't see.

One public file is Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways." The name is spelled differently, so it may be a different company, and I didn't use it as evidence either way. Nothing needed approval and no mail was sent.
